svg.title: Azure commerce service, network and managed identity architecture
svg.desc: Code-defined reference, not live inventory. Container Apps and AKS are alternative installations. Private endpoint NICs are inside the VNet; Cosmos, ACR, Key Vault and conditional model accounts are Azure-managed services outside it. Exact identity and RBAC scopes, public telemetry exceptions and operator prerequisites are shown and documented in azure-service-architecture.md.

Cosmos DB for NoSQL | R1
SQL grants: APIs/workers -> runtime; gateways -> identity container
Database + 2 /pk containers; TTL; autoscale; public/local auth OFF
Account MI: none. Atomic batches stay within one logical partition.
ACR Premium | R2
AcrPull: ACA pull UAMI OR AKS node UAMI, registry scope only
MI: none | private data endpoint | admin/public/bypass OFF
Key Vault Standard | R3
Gateways -> referenced secret names; WAF UAMI -> TLS secret
MI: none | RBAC | purge protection | public/bypass OFF
Operator seeds secrets/certificates; no vault-wide runtime grants
Conditional Azure OpenAI S0 + deployments | R4
Four API/worker UAMIs: OpenAI User at configured account scope
New account MI: none | public/local auth OFF | Responses API
Existing account settings are not changed; verify them separately
Conditional Foundry AIServices + commerce project | R5
Account + project each have a new SystemAssigned MI
No outbound role grants authored for those two resource MIs
Caller role: actions=[]; dataActions=Microsoft.CognitiveServices/*
Four API/worker UAMIs at dedicated account scope; NOT message-only
Anthropic deployments; new account public/local auth OFF; preview gate
Application Insights | R6
MI: none; local auth disabled; 6 callers -> Metrics Publisher @ component
Public-platform ingestion via controlled egress; no private endpoint
Log Analytics workspace | PerGB2018 / 30 days
MI: none; no authored runtime query role; platform metric diagnostics
ACA env logs use workspace key; AKS Container Insights optional
LIVE VERIFICATION IS STILL REQUIRED
Generated AKS identities/grants and inherited access are platform-managed.
No firewall/model log sink or end-to-end TLS is implied by this drawing.
Blue: ingress | Teal: private data/DNS | Purple: existing private access / controlled egress | R1-R7: exact grant matrix below

Private networking is not encryption: AKS WAF -> managed Gateway is HTTP/80; no mesh mTLS is configured.
Tenant/principal/merchant approval checks are application-enforced; Cosmos RBAC is container-scoped, not partition-scoped.
